words.zh: 走；达到；运转；趋于
words.ex_en: The plate went crashing to the floor.
words.ex_zh: 盘子哗啦一声掉在地板上。

words.zh: 好的；优良的；愉快的；虔诚的
words.ex_en: a good hotel
words.ex_zh: 一家不错的宾馆

words.zh: 力量，能力；电力，功率；政权，势力；[数] 幂
words.ex_en: They seized power in a military coup.
words.ex_zh: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

words.zh: 政治的；党派的
words.ex_en: All other political parties there have been completely banned.
words.ex_zh: 那里的其他所有政党都已经完全被取缔了。

words.zh: 发展；生长；渐渐变得…
words.ex_en: a tree which will grow well in most types of soil
words.ex_zh: 在大部分土壤里都能生长得很好的一种树

words.zh: 处理；加工
words.ex_en: Goats’ cheese may be processed in many ways.
words.ex_zh: 山羊奶干酪可以有多种加工方法。

words.zh: 哦；哎呀（表示惊讶或恐惧等）
words.ex_en: ‘Frances has left her husband, you know.’ ‘Oh, has she?’
words.ex_zh: “你知道，弗朗西丝跟她丈夫分开了。”“哦，真的吗？”

words.zh: 国家；民族；国民
words.ex_en: the President’s radio broadcast to the nation
words.ex_zh: 总统对全国的广播讲话

words.zh: 比率，率；速度；价格；等级
words.ex_en: Immediately his heart rate (= the number of beats per minute ) increased.
words.ex_zh: 他的心率立即加快了。

words.zh: 联邦的；同盟的；联邦政府的； 联邦制的
words.ex_en: Switzerland is a federal republic.
words.ex_zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

words.zh: 向…课税；使负重担
words.ex_en: Cigarettes are heavily taxed in Britain.
words.ex_zh: 在英国，香烟被课以重税。

words.zh: 主任，主管；导演；人事助理
words.ex_en: The company is run by a board of directors (= a group of directors ) .
words.ex_zh: 这家公司由董事会管理。

words.zh: 官方的， 政府的； 公务的
words.ex_en: an official investigation into the causes of the explosion
words.ex_zh: 对此次爆炸事件原因的官方调查

words.zh: 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像
words.ex_en: A hexagon is a six-sided figure.
words.ex_zh: 六边形是一种有六条边的几何图形。

words.zh: 简单地；仅仅；简直；朴素地；坦白地
words.ex_en: This work is simply not good enough.
words.ex_zh: 这工作做得实在不够好。

words.zh: 证据，证明；迹象；明显
words.ex_en: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
words.ex_zh: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

words.zh: 很可能的；合适的；有希望的
words.ex_en: the three most likely candidates for president
words.ex_zh: 最有可能当选的三位总统候选人

words.zh: 管理；行政；实施；行政机构
words.ex_en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
words.ex_zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

words.zh: 作战；参加竞选；参加活动
words.ex_en: Jones ran a good campaign.
words.ex_zh: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

words.zh: 防卫，防护；防御措施；防守
words.ex_en: Of course, we'll consult closely with our allies every step of the way, because the security and defense of our allies, both in Europe and Asia, is not negotiable.
words.ex_zh: 当然，我们将在前行道路上就每一步骤与我们的盟国密切磋商，因为我们欧洲和亚洲盟国的安全与防卫是不容讨价还价的。
